evidence: Start at Queensberry car park and climb the Pisa Range Ridge Track.
The track continues past Mt Dottrel at 1690 metres, and terminates at the Pisa Range Conservation Area boundary just before Mitre Rocks.
Note: There is no exit on the Mitre Rocks/Lowburn side, trampers must return same way or use alternate exits described here.

doubts: DOC gives '10 hr one way', but there is no exit at the end (near Mitre Rocks), so trampers must return the same way or leave by one of the alternate exits; shape is recorded as one_way for the track itself. Lake McKay is described as a point of interest/view and may only be seen rather than passed; The Column Rocks are only said to be seen. The Cardrona-Cromwell Pack Track connection is not described as to where it joins the ridge (the Mitre Rocks link is on private property).
